answer: Sybil resistance requires each agent key to be registered with a fresh remote-attestation report showing an approved MRENCLAVE and a valid hardware-backed platform chain. Copying a VM or key cannot forge that evidence; under a one-identity-per-platform policy, creating another accepted identity requires access to additional physical silicon, not simple VM duplication. Nonces limit replay, while spiral, knoll, and zephyr are only agent labels, not credentials.
